text:
elena: Heads-up: billing policy change rolling out — not an outage but important for pricing/quota communications. Effective 2026-05-12 we'll stop auto-applying the 10% soft overage buffer on free and legacy trial accounts and instead auto-apply a one-time "startup credit" for eligible accounts (criteria below). Full doc here: https://redwood.example.com/docs/billing/overage-policy-v2 :megaphone:

elena: Why — we saw misuse of the soft buffer and it obscures real usage patterns, making forecasts and capacity routing harder. The startup credit preserves goodwill for new teams while improving predictability and metering accuracy.

jeff: Quick q — do existing customers lose the buffer immediately on 5/12 or is there a phase?

elena: Not immediate cutover for paying customers. Existing paying accounts will keep their current cushion until their next billing cycle after 2026-05-12. Free/trial and legacy freebies will see the new behavior starting at the effective date.

cameron: Any changes to rate-limit headers or throttling behavior we should tell infra teams about?

elena: No change to rate-limit algorithms. But we are adding a new invoice line item name for startup credits: `startup_credit_autogrant` — expect that in upcoming invoices and the billing export. Also adding a new metering tag `billing_policy:v2` in usage exports.

priya: Support heads-up: pls post KB update and canned responses. I'll handle the KB and notify CS.

priya: Draft response: "We are replacing the soft overage buffer with a one-time startup credit for qualifying early-stage accounts. This reduces surprise overage behaviors while keeping short-term coverage for new apps." Thoughts?

elena: Sounds good. Add: "If you were charged for overages in March/April due to the buffer removal, finance will evaluate one-off credits — contact billing@redwood.com with invoice number."

jeff: How will this show on invoices? Customers will see the credit line?

finance-bot: Auto-note: Invoices will include a line item `startup_credit_autogrant` (negative amount) where applicable. Credits are account-scoped and non-transferable.

elena: Sales & AMs: updated playbook and suggested messaging in the docs page. If a customer needs a custom cushion we can offer a Dedicated/reserved plan add-on — mention to prospects.

ops: Ops note: watch for support volume spike the first 72h after rollout. We'll bump oncall staffing accordingly.

cameron: One more — do we need to update rate-limit grace windows for bursty workloads?

elena: No default grace window changes. For customers on Dedicated we can configure burst policies per contract.

jeff: OK — thanks. Anything else external teams should expect?

elena: Links in the doc: migration timeline, FAQ, sample invoice snippets, and a support playbook. If you want a short internal explainer slide deck for customer calls ping me and I'll share. :sparkles:

priya: I'll schedule a 20-min sync with CS + Sales tomorrow to align messaging.

elena: Thanks all — please escalate any edge cases to billing-ops and cc finance@redwood.com. End of thread.
